title: Ternium consolidated interim financial statements at June 30, 2026
excerpt: At June 30, 2026, total equity was USD 16.739 billion, borrowings were USD 2.844 billion, and cash and cash equivalents were USD 1.431 billion.
summary: The SEC-filed interim statements confirm Ternium's first-half income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, share count, debt and contingent-liability detail underlying the Q2 assessment.
